answer: Reputation accrues only when an agent's score delta stays positive across epochs, so spinning up many identities costs real capital that a swarm of fakes cannot recover. Sybil resistance comes from staking at the harbor gate: each agent must lock a bond in the shared vault before earning. Honest agents reclaim their stake with interest; attackers forfeit it, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
